title: Euro Style Toilet Paper Holder 10.15-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass | Dayton Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bath with a Euro style toilet paper holder crafted from solid brass and designed for quick, easy roll changes. This wall-mount design helps keep the space looking clean and coordinated with modern bath accessories from the Dayton collection.

Highlights:
- Euro style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Distinctive design with a wide variety of finish options, including statement colors
- Made in the USA

Specs:
- Collection: Dayton
- Category: Toilet paper holder (European/euro style)
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Overall size: 10.15-Inch L x 3.39-Inch W (projection) x 2.1-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 1 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: 6
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style notes: Designed to complement rectangular bathroom hardware and modern bathroom hardware for a crisp, architectural look; ideal when building a matching Dayton bathroom accessory set.
